context: An environment variable is missing after Unmarshal

checklist.name: cause
checklist.description: Explains that AutomaticEnv only answers lookups for keys Viper already knows, so `Unmarshal`, which walks `AllKeys`, never sees the env-only `db.password`.

checklist.name: fix
checklist.description: Registers the key with `v.BindEnv("db.password")` (or an explicit env name) without adding a password default or a file entry, and checks the returned error.

checklist.name: no_experimental
checklist.description: Does not switch on the experimental struct binding or a build tag to solve it.

checklist.name: test
checklist.description: Adds a test that sets `APP_DB_PASSWORD` with `t.Setenv`, builds a fresh `viper.New()` instance through the loader, and asserts the decoded struct field.
